title: Listen Before You Speak: Response Planning from Listener Facial Reactions for Conversational Speech Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.21683v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational speech depends on dialogue context and the listener's immediately preceding behavior. We propose ReACT-TTS, a two-stage framework that uses a one-second pre-response listener facial sequence to plan the next utterance's emotion and prosody before speech realization. On a strict dyadic MELD protocol, Temporal conditioning yields higher mean macro-F1 and VAD concordance than Text-only across ten seeds, while accuracy remains essentially unchanged. Ablations show that temporal modeling performs best among the visual variants and that an explicit early-to-late difference is unnecessary; correct listener reactions also outperform cyclic mismatches on average. In a contextual-appropriateness study with 20 speech researchers, 76% of judgments prefer Temporal, 9% Text-only, and 15% report no preference. translated_title: 先倾听后发言：基于倾听者面部反应的会话语音生成响应规划
translated_abstract: 会话语音依赖于对话上下文以及倾听者紧邻之前的行为。我们提出了ReACT-TTS，一个两阶段框架，它利用响应前一秒的倾听者面部序列，在语音实现之前规划下一句话的情感和韵律。在严格的二元MELD协议上，跨十个随机种子，时间条件化比仅文本条件化取得了更高的平均宏F1和VAD一致性，而准确率基本保持不变。消融实验表明，时间建模在视觉变体中表现最佳，且显式的早期到晚期差异建模是不必要的；正确的倾听者反应平均也优于循环错配。在一项有20名语音研究人员参与的上下文适宜性研究中，76%的判断偏好时间条件化，9%偏好仅文本条件化，15%表示无偏好。我们进一步将预测的响应风格连接到Grad-TTS骨干网络，以实现端到端的语音合成。总体而言，这些结果支持……
tldr: ReACT-TTS提出了一种两阶段框架，利用倾听者前一秒的面部反应序列来规划回复的情感与韵律，并结合Grad-TTS实现更符合对话情境的端到端语音生成。
en_tdlr: ReACT-TTS is a two-stage framework that leverages a one-second pre-response listener facial sequence to plan the emotion and prosody of the next utterance, enabling contextually appropriate end-to-end conversational speech generation with a Grad-TTS backbone.
